Category: General SupportYou may close your ticket anytime by clicking the button belowClose TicketBEE Manager 🐝 pinned a message to this channel.Hello B.E.E hive

Recently, autobuilder theft has been on the rise, and one of my resorts (Waveside) was one of the latest targets.

Because of this, Hippy (an Oasis owner) and I have developed a private Discord bot and server to help Bloxburg communities protect themselves. The server will be invite-only, with the goal of allowing trusted communities to share information about known autobuilders, members who have been banned from participating groups, and active raid warnings.

I wanted to ask if B.E.E Hive would be interested in joining this programme.

So far, the following communities are involved:

* Oasis Resorts Bloxburg (880 members)
* Bloxburg Aviation Community (1,400 members)
* Lexington Hotels (3,100 members)
* AMAN Resorts (1,300 members)

## About the bot
The bot will be connected to a shared database of banned members. If someone in that database joins a participating server, the bot will automatically alert that server’s administrators, allowing them to review the situation and take any action they feel is appropriate.
The bot doesn’t need administrator permissions and never asks for them.
What the bot does is that every time a user gets added to the blacklist database and is in your server, the bot will alert you in a selected channel.
The moderators will then be given the option to ban them, or just ignore the warning, or do whatever deemed necessary.
This also goes for new users too, where if a user joins the server and is on the blacklist, it will warn the moderators in the same way.

If you’d like any more information or have any questions, I’d be happy to answer them.Pictures of the bot in action

This image below is for the moderators when a user has been put on the global blacklist .
This will be in a selected channel with a selected ping. Both of these are completely customisable.
The moderators will be given a choice to ban or ignore. Wizzy can ban the user, however you can disable its permissions and ban the user yourself. If the moderators choose to ignore it, Wizzy won’t do anything.Server in action
This is what it looks like in the Wizzy server (which is invite only) when a new user has been put on the global blacklist.
